test_MultiIndex_slice_locs: test the MultiIndex slice_locs method for partial and exact range lookups on sorted and unsorted indexes
test_MultiIndex_putmask: test the MultiIndex putmask method for replacing values with a mask and another MultiIndex
test_MultiIndex_get_indexer: test the MultiIndex get_indexer method with pad, backfill, ffill, bfill methods and missing values
test_MultiIndex_get_loc: test the MultiIndex get_loc and get_loc_level methods for label lookups with various dtypes and NaN handling
test_MultiIndex_contains: test the MultiIndex contains operator for membership checks with dropped levels and missing values
test_MultiIndex_getitem: test the MultiIndex getitem method for scalar, slice, and boolean indexing operations
test_MultiIndex_get_locs: test the MultiIndex get_locs method for list-like key selection with reordering and NaN handling
test_MultiIndex_where_raises: test that the MultiIndex where method raises NotImplementedError for all input types
